error_page_unreadable: Ba za a iya karanta wannan shafi ba. Ba a tallafa wa shafukan mai bincike, Chrome Web Store da fayilolin PDF ba.
error_no_content: Ba a sami rubutun maƙala a wannan shafi ba.
error_needs_click: Danna alamar tsawaitawa don taƙaita wannan shafi. Bayan shafin ya koma wani shafi, tsawaitawar tana buƙatar sabon dannawa don karanta shi.
error_host_missing: Ba a shigar da ɓangaren gida ba ko kuma ba ya amsawa. A cikin jakar tsawaitawar, gudanar da: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: Ba a sami Claude Code ba. Shigar da shi, sannan ka sake gudanar da ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_auth: Ba ka shiga Claude Code ba. Gudanar da claude a cikin tasha ka shiga.
error_codex_signed_out: Ba ka shiga Codex ba. Gudanar da codex login a cikin tasha.
error_codex_not_eligible: Ba za a iya amfani da tsarin ChatGPT ɗinka don wannan ba. Zaɓi wani mai bayarwa.
error_usage_limit: Ka kai iyakar amfani na tsarinka. Sake gwadawa daga baya ko ka zaɓi wani mai bayarwa.
error_provider_failed: Mai bayarwa ya kasa yayin rubuta taƙaitawar. Sake gwadawa.
error_codex_missing: Ba a sami Codex ba. Shigar da shi, sannan ka sake gudanar da ./native-host/install.sh
options_models_empty: Jerin samfura ba zai iya zama fanko ba.
options_help: Taƙaitawa na wucewa ta ɓangaren gida, wanda ke gudanar da Claude Code ko Codex a wannan kwamfuta da biyan kuɗinka. Ana aika rubutun shafin ga mai bayarwar da ka zaɓa kawai.
